boundary_isolation_checks.cold: Replay command and later quality intent absent on both sides of the Prefill sample.

boundary_isolation_checks.independent_checks: Prefill queue samples and persistent file metadata are reported separately. Client success and accepted scores come from the formal raw request audit.

scope: The original processes are still live. Neither future terminal boundary nor benchmark acceptance is verified here.
